summary: The existing exhaustive Chromium test was run directly and passed for all declared PARTIAL Editor node types. A prior read-only gap audit had proposed this media lifecycle as missing; source inspection showed it is already covered by the existing isolated real-Worker media storage test, so no duplicate implementation or test was added.

test_source.scope: 44 declared PARTIAL node types plus root; Inspector route and registry parity, explicit Save and reload round-trip, separate Publish, responsive, visibility, hover and keyboard-focus state.

source_readback.method: GitHub v2/foundation file readback SHA compared with local working-file Git blob SHA

related_existing_coverage.coverage: Existing real Worker + isolated D1/R2 lifecycle uploads WAV, MP3, OGG and WebM; verifies private preview and unpublished 404; authors audio/video nodes through the real Inspector picker; verifies site isolation, Save/reload without publication, then separate Publish and exact bytes/MIME/public player behavior.

failure.test: EDT-039 page actions and EDT-040 motion save as draft, preview safely, and publish separately
failure.assertion: a direct deep link restores the selected tab on page load
failure.diagnosis: The browser test read aria-selected immediately after the public target node was attached; it did not wait for the asynchronous public page interaction initialization that applies the URL state. The runtime URL-state implementation applies the requested tab during that initialization.

follow_up_regression.change: Wait for the expected tab selection before asserting direct deep-link, browser Back/Forward and invalid-index outcomes, removing the hydration timing race without weakening URL-state expectations.

production_readback.exact_source_smoke: Existing evidence for runtime commit 886b387d01a461a6483d796519629008a5cbdf75 records /api/health HTTP 200 and exact public asset hashes. This turn's direct curl health read was blocked because the sandbox proxy at localhost:8080 was unavailable; no new health PASS is claimed.
